entries.title: Moon and hospital visits
entries.content: Studies of thousands of psychiatric admissions and emergency visits found no link to the moon's phases. Visits and stays were the same at full moon.
entries.source: Is it the moon? Effects of the lunar cycle on psychiatric admissions - PubMed
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Moon and births
entries.content: Research on hundreds of thousands of births found no real lunar effect on birth rates or complications.
entries.source: No Evidence of Purported Lunar Effect on Hospital Admission Rates or Birth Rates
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Why the myth lasts
entries.content: Reviews of dozens of studies find the moon explains almost none of the change in behavior. The belief lasts because we remember the wild full-moon nights and forget the quiet ones.
entries.source: The Moon Was Full and Nothing Happened: A Review of Studies on the Moon and Human Behavior
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: How Giun uses the moon
entries.content: We use moon phases as ritual timing: an intention at the new moon, a check-in at the full moon. We never blame the moon for how you or anyone else acts.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
